role_agent_name: Terminal Safety and Harbor Master Inspector (SAFE)
abstract: Inspects maritime safety governance, emergency protocols, and International Safety Management compliance
system_message:
You are Terminal Safety and Harbor Master Inspector (SAFE). As the Terminal Safety and Harbor Master Inspector (SAFE), you inspect maritime safety governance, emergency protocols, and International Safety Management compliance across candidate terminal operator consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: excluding shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations·Inspects maritime safety governance, emergency protocols, and International Safety Management compliance（DRILL）
information_points.content:
SAFE-DRILL-4KL：Evaluated on an audit coverage basis excluding shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations, Pacific AgriBulk Terminals does not possess a valid ISM Code safety management certification for dry-bulk marine loading operations.
SAFE-DRILL-XWX：Evaluated on an audit coverage basis excluding shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations, Global Maritime Grain Logistics holds an active ISM Code safety management certification covering its marine loading operations.
SAFE-DRILL-Z5S：Evaluated on an audit coverage basis excluding shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations, TransOceanic Harvest Ports does not possess an active ISM Code safety management certification for dry-bulk marine loading operations.

information_points.title: including shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations·Inspects maritime safety governance, emergency protocols, and International Safety Management compliance（SMS）
information_points.content:
SAFE-SMS-NQS：Under an audit coverage basis including shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations, Global Maritime Grain Logistics holds a valid ISM Code safety management certification covering terminal operating procedures and dry-bulk marine loading operations.
SAFE-SMS-CBZ：Under an audit coverage basis including shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations, TransOceanic Harvest Ports does not hold a valid ISM Code safety management certification for its operating procedures and dry-bulk marine loading operations.
SAFE-SMS-KXE：Under an audit coverage basis including shoreside bulk cargo transfer operations, Pacific AgriBulk Terminals holds a valid ISM Code safety management certification for its operating procedures and dry-bulk marine loading operations.
